info.title: canix402 API
info.description: x402-gated DeFi data and walletless transaction API, including best price swaps, prerequisite opt-ins, and paid atomic swap-group generation. Numeric yield/USD fields (apy, apr, tvlUsd) are returned with a standard precision of 6 decimal places, extended up to 12 decimal places only when needed to represent small non-zero values. Asset decimals are always sourced on-chain from algod. pragma: allowlist secret
info.x-guidance: Use the gateway base URL in servers[0]. Fetch /discovery and /openapi.json before integrating. Prefer the remote canix402 MCP server at https://canix402-mcp.compx.io/mcp (streamable-http, walletless pass-through) for agent tool access. Paid routes return HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; sign a USDC ASA transfer client-side and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Best price swaps follow quote -> opt-in if needed -> fresh quote -> paid transaction generation -> local signing/submission. Human and LLM docs: https://canix402.compx.io/llms.txt pragma: allowlist secret

x-precision.notes: Values are rounded to 6 decimal places by default; precision is extended up to 12 decimal places when 6 would collapse a small non-zero value to zero.

get.summary: Top 10 aggregated DeFi opportunities ranked by risk then APY
get.description: Returns ranked DeFi yield opportunities across supported chains (Algorand and Base). Each row includes chain. Default list mixes Algorand venues with listed Morpho Vaults on Base. Filter with protocol= or chain=algorand|base. This endpoint provides normalized market data only; it does not build or submit transactions.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Omit to include every supported chain.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass Redis and refetch adapters; still writes a fresh cache entry. Default false.

get.summary: Caller-filtered opportunities across supported platforms
get.description: Returns DeFi opportunities filtered by platform, chain (algorand|base), opportunity type, APY range, TVL threshold, and optional ASA assetIds. Base Morpho rows use assetAddresses instead of assetIds. This endpoint provides normalized market data only; it does not build or submit transactions.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Omit to include every supported chain.

parameters.name: assetIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated Algorand ASA ids (0 = ALGO). Keeps opportunities whose assetIds intersect any requested id. Rows without assetIds do not match when this filter is set.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass Redis and refetch adapters; still writes a fresh cache entry. Default false.

get.summary: Top opportunities tuned to a wallet's held assets
get.description: Returns Algorand DeFi opportunities whose underlying assets match a supplied wallet's holdings, including opted-in ASAs with positive balance and native ALGO when held. Matching applies POST /eligibility rules (min amount, ASA gates, capacity, unresolved NFD/creator gates) so full or gated venues are not recommended as enterable. Each row includes canEnter and eligibilityFullyCheckable; quote-time on-chain checks remain authoritative. Use POST /eligibility for the diagnostic (missingAssets, gates, capacity, suggestedSwap). This endpoint provides normalized market data only; it does not build or submit transactions.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Algorand account address to personalize opportunities for.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass Redis and refetch adapters; still writes a fresh cache entry. Default false.

get.summary: Bounded APY/TVL history for one opportunity
get.description: Returns a rolling APY and TVL series for one opportunity over a bounded window (1d, 7d, or 30d). Snapshots are stored as cheap hourly Redis buckets for ~30 days only — not a warehouse and not backfilled from explorers. The series is empty until the snapshot job has run. Includes a stability signal (APY stdev / sample count) so snapshot APY cannot dominate plan sizing. Market data only; Canix does not sign or submit transactions.

parameters.name: opportunityId
parameters.description: Stable opportunity identifier from catalog rows.

200.description: Bounded APY/TVL series. points is empty when no snapshots exist yet.

post.summary: Wallet eligibility and capacity for selected opportunities
post.description: Checks whether a wallet can enter one or more opportunities before requesting an execution quote. Resolves Réti entryRequirements and capacity (min amount, ASA gates, staker slots, ALGO room). NFD and creator gates are published as unresolved — canEnter is never true until eligibilityFullyCheckable is true. Returns missingAssets, gates, capacity, and an optional suggestedSwap hint (not a live quote). Quote-time on-chain checks remain authoritative. Canix does not sign or submit transactions.

200.description: Eligibility diagnostics for the requested opportunities

post.summary: Compile an allocation intent into an ordered unsigned plan
post.description: Agent states an allocation intent (address, budget/asset, constraints such as max protocol weight, no new borrows, execution-ready only, TVL/freshness floors). Canix returns ordered steps: eligibility, optional live multi-router swap compose (opt-in → swap → enter, driven by requiredAssetIds), protocol setup chains, and enter quotes as independent unsigned groups (never merged). Reuses quotes[] / order / prerequisiteShapeKeys. Includes expected position delta, x402 + network fee totals, and expiry. Quote-time on-chain checks remain authoritative. Canix does not sign or submit. Brownie and other agents should consume POST /plans rather than forking a compiler.

200.description: Ordered unsigned plan with eligibility, quotes[], and fee totals

post.summary: Compile a delta rebalance plan of unsigned groups
post.description: Positions are the book; opportunities are the menu. Pass address plus targetWeights (bps summing to 10000) and/or harvestIdle to claim worth-claiming rewards and redeploy idle ALGO. Returns ordered unsigned groups — claims, partial exits, optional multi-router swap compose, and enters — only the delta legs that change the book (not a full unwind-and-rebuild). Reuses claim desk, eligibility, compose, and position exit/manage shapeKeys. Groups are never merged. Canix does not sign or submit.

200.description: Ordered unsigned delta plan with claims, exits, and enters

post.summary: Validate a compiled plan or quotes[] against an operator policy document
post.description: Operators bring policy; Canix evaluates a compiled plan (or proposed quotes[]) against a versioned policy document (max protocol weight, ALGO reserve floor, TVL/freshness floors, no-new-borrows, execution-ready only). Returns { pass, reasons[] }. Reuses plan/eligibility/risk fields already on the compiled object and fails closed when a required field is missing — it does not re-quote on-chain. Canix does not sign or submit. Brownie and a second agent can share the same schema (protocol/docs/policy-schema.md).

200.description: Machine-readable pass/fail; never signed or submitted

get.summary: Algorand DeFi positions held by a wallet
get.description: Returns normalized DeFi positions associated with a supplied Algorand wallet address across supported protocols. LP tokens indexed by HOGSWAP (STAMM, AlgoFi, Humble) are valued via GET /lp/{asset_id}?amount= — proportional NAV, null rather than guessed. Tinyman and Pact LP collectors remain canonical for those venues (no double-count by LP ASA). This endpoint provides position data only; it does not build or submit transactions.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Algorand account address whose DeFi positions should be returned.

get.summary: Claimable DeFi rewards across supported protocols
get.description: Returns claimable reward rows for a wallet with USD value, network-fee / worth-claiming hints, compatible claim shapeKeys, and ready-to-POST quote inputs. Use claimAllQuotes (or selected per-row quotes) with POST /execution/quotes to compile unsigned claim groups — groups are never merged. Covers Tinyman farm, stALGO TINY claim, CompX staking, Pact farm, Haystack, and Alpha Arcade. This endpoint does not build or submit transactions.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Algorand account address whose claimable rewards should be returned.

get.summary: Public DeFi positions for the Brownie Bot showcase wallet
get.description: Free showcase route that returns normalized DeFi positions for the Brownie Bot treasury wallet only. The wallet address is hardcoded server-side — this is not a general free /positions browser. Use GET /positions?address= for arbitrary wallets (paid).

get.summary: Top 25 DeFi opportunities for a single protocol ranked by risk then APY
get.description: Returns ranked DeFi opportunities for one protocol including morpho (Base listed Morpho Vaults). This endpoint provides normalized market data only; it does not build or submit transactions.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass Redis and refetch adapters; still writes a fresh cache entry. Default false.

get.summary: List verified execution shape catalog metadata
get.description: Returns the live catalog of verified transaction shapes (shapeKey, requiredInputs, opportunityRole, docsPath). meta.caveatsDocsPath points at protocol-specific construction caveats. Catalog metadata only — does not compile quotes or return unsigned transactions. Use POST /execution/quotes to compile executable groups. Do not guess pool discovery, opt-ins, min-balance, slippage, liquidity limits, or app upgrades. Read protocol/docs/execution-shapes/protocol-caveats.md (GET /execution/shapes meta.caveatsDocsPath) and each shape's docsPath.

post.summary: Compile a verified transaction shape into unsigned Algorand transactions
post.description: Accepts `{ quotes: [{ shapeKey, input }, ...] }` (min 1) and returns an array of fresh, validated, unsigned transaction groups in request order. Groups are never merged across quotes. On failure the whole request fails and error.details includes quoteIndex and shapeKey. Price is flat per request (not per quote item). Use when an agent has selected one or more DeFi actions and needs deterministic transaction bytes to sign locally. Currently supports all five Tinyman v2 LP shapes (flexible/initial/single-asset add; multiple-assets-out/single-asset-out remove), Tinyman v2 swap shapes (swap:fixedInput / swap:fixedOutput via Tinyman Swap Router, falling back to a single Tinyman pool when the router is not better; Tinyman-pool only, never a cross-DEX aggregator), Tinyman farm shapes (staking-v1 farm:commit / farm:uncommit / farm:claimRewards; v2 addLiquidityAndFarm flexible/single-asset that add liquidity and commit the new LP position in one atomic group, with LP tokens remaining in the wallet), Tinyman liquid-stake/restake shapes (liquid-stake-v1 mint/burn tALGO; restake-v1 increaseStake/decreaseStake/claimRewards stALGO), Folks Finance v2 lending escrow shapes (setup depositEscrow/optEscrowAsset; deposit:escrow; withdraw:escrow), Folks Finance v2 loan credit shapes (setup:loanEscrow; setup:addCollateral; collateral:sync / collateral:reduce; borrow:variable; repay:withTxn), Folks Finance xALGO liquid-stake shapes (xalgo-v1 stake/unstake immediate), Pact v1 LP add/remove shapes, Pact Smart Router unsigned swap (`mainnet:pact:smart-router:swap:fixed-input`; local graph + Pool.prepareSwap, not Haystack), CompX v1 lending shapes (deposit/withdraw ASA; borrow:asa; repay:asa) and CompX v1 staking shapes, Dork.fi v1 ASA lending shapes (deposit/withdraw; borrow:asa; repay:asa), Myth Finance dualSTAKE shapes (dualstake-v1 mint/redeem LST; farm yield accrues passively while holding the LST), Haystack v1 single-token HAY staking shapes (stake HAY; unstake HAY and claim USDC+HAY rewards; claim USDC+HAY rewards), Réti v1 ALGO staking shapes (stake/unstake), Alpha Arcade v1 ALPHA staking shapes (stake/unstake/claim USDC), and STAMM v1 LP mint/redeem via HOGSWAP (unsigned groups; do not hardcode router app ids), and HOGSWAP v1 swap shapes (fixed-input / fixed-output; unsigned groups; routing fee already netted into expectedOut; do not hardcode router app ids). Canix does not sign or submit transactions in this endpoint. Do not guess pool discovery, opt-ins, min-balance, slippage, liquidity limits, or app upgrades. Read protocol/docs/execution-shapes/protocol-caveats.md (GET /execution/shapes meta.caveatsDocsPath) and each shape's docsPath.

post.summary: Compose opt-in → winning swap → enter as unmerged unsigned groups
post.description: Compiles “I hold asset A, I want this opportunity” into sequenced groups: optional ASA/app opt-in, multi-router swap (signer indexes and pre-signed members preserved), then enter — driven by requiredAssetIds. Groups are never merged. Failure modes (stale quote, missing opt-in, slippage) are listed on step warnings. Canix does not sign or submit. Caller signs user legs and submits locally in order. Quote-time on-chain checks remain authoritative.

200.description: Sequenced unsigned opt-in, winning swap, and enter groups

post.summary: Simulate compiled unsigned groups for predicted balance and position deltas
post.description: Given compiled unsigned group(s) from a plan or execution quote, returns predicted wallet balance and position deltas without signing or submitting. Fails closed with machine-readable reasons when the group would not succeed (stale quote, not opted in, min balance, health factor too low, capacity). Canix does not sign or submit. POST /plans attaches the same simulation summary when compiled groups are available.

200.description: Predicted deltas and fail-closed reasons; never signed or submitted

post.summary: Fetch USD token prices for Algorand asset IDs
post.description: Returns CompX USD oracle prices for the requested Algorand asset IDs. A null price indicates that CompX has no current price for that asset.

200.description: Current CompX USD prices for requested assets

post.summary: Fetch a walletless multi-router swap quote
post.description: Quotes every enabled swap router in parallel, scores expected net out, and returns the winning serializable quote without signing or submitting. Pass optional router to force a single adapter. Asset amounts are integer base units. Use the returned quote unchanged with /swaps/optin and /swaps/transactions. If prerequisite opt-ins are submitted, fetch a fresh quote before building the swap group.

200.description: Serializable multi-router quote, winning router, and opaque payload

post.summary: Build prerequisite swap opt-ins for the winning quote
post.description: Checks the supplied Algorand account against the winning quote and returns a fresh unsigned group containing any missing output-asset and required application opt-ins. An empty transaction group means no opt-ins are required. canix402 is walletless: the caller signs and submits every returned opt-in transaction locally, waits for confirmation, and then refreshes the quote before requesting swap transactions. This route does not claim that returned opt-ins have executed.

200.description: Unsigned prerequisite group, or an empty group when no opt-ins are missing

post.summary: Build a walletless swap transaction group from the winning quote
post.description: Paid transaction-generation step for a fresh multi-router quote. The initial request may return 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; satisfy the advertised 0.005 USDC requirement and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. On success, the response preserves transaction order, identifies caller members in userSignIndexes, and includes any pre-signed members from the winning router. Sign only the userSignIndexes members, combine them with the pre-signed members in the original order, and submit the complete atomic group through your own Algod client. canix402 never receives wallet keys and never submits the swap. The 0.005 USDC x402 access charge is separate from Haystack's SDK-default 10 bps output fee (including referral split), other router fees, DEX fees, route price impact, and Algorand network transaction fees.

200.description: Ordered, walletless swap group ready for caller signing

post.summary: Buy a prepaid agent session receipt
post.description: One compiler-priced x402 payment mints a walletless prepaid session receipt (canix://session/{sessionId}). The receipt unlocks N research calls and M quotes/plans until TTL. Sessions are receipts, not keys. Exact-scheme one-shots remain the default; omit X-Canix-Session to pay per request. Fail-closed on expiry, exhausted quota, or store unavailability.

200.description: Minted prepaid session receipt with remaining N/M

post.summary: Refresh a prepaid agent session receipt
post.description: Compiler-priced x402 payment that resets N/M quota and TTL on an existing session id, or mints a new receipt if the previous one is gone. Cannot be paid with an existing session — this route is one-shot only.

200.description: Refreshed prepaid session receipt with remaining N/M

get.summary: Read prepaid session remaining N/M
get.description: Returns the session receipt including remaining research and quotes/plans quota and expiry. Agents should use this resource instead of the public indexer /transactions showcase. Fail-closed 402 when the receipt is unknown or expired. Exhausted-but-unexpired receipts return 200 with status exhausted.

post.summary: Register a paid wallet watch retainer
post.description: Recurring compiler-priced x402 retainer that registers a walletless watch (address + thresholds + optional HTTPS webhook). Fires signed, idempotent notifications on health-factor, claimable-USD, APY-drop, or Réti-capacity crossings. Canix never stores wallet keys — only the address, callback, and a server-generated HMAC secret (shown once). Refresh with POST /watch/refresh before TTL. MCP resource canix://watch/{watchId} lists recent firings.

200.description: Registered watch receipt with HMAC secret shown once

post.summary: Refresh a paid wallet watch retainer
post.description: Compiler-priced x402 payment that extends TTL on an existing watch id. Optionally rotateSecret to mint a new HMAC key (returned once). Cannot be paid with a prepaid session. Unknown or expired watches fail-closed; register again with POST /watch.

get.summary: Read watch receipt and recent threshold firings
get.description: Returns the walletless watch receipt including thresholds, webhook URL, expiry, and recent signed-delivery firings (idempotency keys). Does not return the HMAC secret. Unknown or expired receipts fail-closed with 402 WATCH_*.

post.summary: Rotate the watch webhook HMAC secret
post.description: Mints a new webhook signing secret. Requires the current secret in X-Canix-Watch-Secret. The new secret is returned once and never stored as a wallet key. Does not extend retainer TTL — pay POST /watch/refresh for that.

200.description: Rotated watch receipt with new HMAC secret shown once

details.description: Optional structured context for the error.

WatchThresholds.description: At least one threshold is required. Health factor fires when the wallet min HF crosses below the value. Claimable USD fires when totals.claimableUsd crosses at or above the value. APY drop fires when an opportunity APY falls by at least this many basis points vs the previous snapshot. Réti capacity fires when a Réti venue becomes constrained.

webhookSecret.description: HMAC secret shown once on create, refresh-with-rotate, or rotate. Never a wallet key.

OpportunityRisk.description: Designed opportunity risk block (schema V2). Optional numeric fields are omitted when unknown rather than invented. confidence is always present.

borrowApr.description: Borrow-side APR cost when the venue supports borrowing. Mirrors top-level borrowApr when present.

healthFactor.description: Wallet health factor for this lending venue when address is in context. Omitted on anonymous catalog rows. Null when positions were loaded but this venue has no HF snapshot.

volatilityBucket.description: LP IL / volatility bucket. unknown when the adapter has no designed signal.

ilHint.description: Human-readable IL hint when a designed signal exists (never a guessed percentage).

rewardRunwayRemaining.description: Farm/staking remaining rewards in base units (decimal string).

confidence.description: Snapshot freshness from fetchedAt / cache age. high ≤ 3 minutes, medium ≤ 1 hour, otherwise low. unknown when timestamps cannot be parsed.

sourceAgeSeconds.description: Seconds between sourceTimestamp and evaluation time.

stability.description: APY stability from the bounded history series (coefficient of variation). unknown when fewer than 3 snapshots exist. Omitted until history is attached.

apyStdev.description: Sample standard deviation of APY over the retained window.

historySampleCount.description: Number of history snapshots used for stability / apyStdev.

opportunityId.description: Stable identifier for the opportunity within its protocol.

assetPair.description: Protocol-specific market identifier (e.g. ALGO/USDC or a single asset).

chain.description: Settlement chain. Required so a mixed Algorand + Base catalog is unambiguous.

assetIds.description: On-chain Algorand asset ids backing the opportunity. Native ALGO is asset id 0.

assetAddresses.description: ERC-20 addresses for EVM venues. Do not put 0x values into assetIds.

apy.description: Yield as APY. Formatted to 6 decimal places (up to 12 for small non-zero values).

yieldBasis.description: Indicates whether the apy field reflects a compound APY or an APR-derived value.

apr.description: Yield as APR when the upstream source provides it. For CompX lending this is the supply APR (same basis as apy).

borrowApr.description: Borrow-side APR cost when the venue supports borrowing against this market. Prefer this field for borrow cost; do not treat apr as borrow cost.

tvlUsd.description: Total value locked / liquidity depth in USD.

sourceTimestamp.description: Upstream or on-chain update time when available; otherwise equals fetchedAt.

fetchedAt.description: When this service fetched and normalized the row.

notes.description: Caveats about timestamp provenance, fallback identifiers, or yield estimates.

executionReady.description: True when at least one enter execution shape is available. When false and executionShapes is empty, treat as research-only and do not invent shape keys.

executionShapes.description: Enter-only shapes for opening this yield opportunity. Empty means research-only.

compatibleExitShapes.description: Exit shapes for closing this opportunity when known (e.g. Folks xALGO unstake, Tinyman tALGO burn). Empty means discover exits via positions or canix_list_execution_shapes / the shape catalog.

canEnter.description: Whether the wallet currently passes checkable entry and capacity rules. Never true when eligibilityFullyCheckable is false.

eligibilityFullyCheckable.description: False when NFD/creator gates are present and cannot be resolved. Use POST /eligibility for the diagnostic.

cacheEnabled.description: True when Redis opportunity cache is configured and not disabled.

cacheHit.description: True when every protocol fetch used in this response was served from Redis.

cachedAt.description: Oldest cache write timestamp among protocols used; null when cache is disabled.

cacheAgeMs.description: Age of cachedAt relative to response time; informational only (no harsh stale flag).

address.description: Algorand address the results were personalized for.

heldAssetCount.description: Number of distinct held assets used for matching.

eligibilityApplied.description: True when ranking used POST /eligibility rules.

eligibilityEndpoint.description: Paid diagnostic endpoint for missingAssets, gates, and capacity.

PositionRecord.description: A protocol-neutral economic position. Integer base units and normalized token amounts are decimal strings to preserve precision.

assetIds.description: Underlying ASA ids for the position (LP asset A/B). Omitted when unknown.

healthFactor.description: Protocol-reported collateral health ratio when applicable.

inputHints.description: Optional selector hints for compatible exit/manage shapes. Amounts never appear.

compatibleExitShapeKeys.description: Exit shape keys compatible with this position. Empty means do not invent keys.

compatibleManageShapeKeys.description: Manage/claim shape keys compatible with this position.

totals.description: Aggregate USD totals. A null value means at least one relevant protocol or position could not be valued completely; null must not be interpreted as zero.

address.description: Algorand address whose positions were queried.

agentId.description: Present on free public showcase routes (for example brownie).

claimKey.description: Stable compile identity used to dedupe claimAllQuotes (e.g. Haystack USDC+HAY share one key).

estimatedNetworkFeeMicroAlgos.description: Conservative network-fee hint in microAlgos (not a simulation).

worthClaiming.description: true when reward USD exceeds estimated network fee USD; null when either side is unknown.

totals.description: Aggregate claim desk totals. A null value means incomplete coverage or pricing; null must not be interpreted as zero.

quotes.description: Deduped quote requests ready for POST /execution/quotes. Groups are never merged.

userAddress.description: Algorand address that will sign the transaction group.

assetAId.description: First asset id identifying the Tinyman pool pair (integer or string).

assetAAmount.description: Amount of asset A in base units for add-liquidity shapes (integer string recommended).

assetBId.description: Second asset id identifying the Tinyman pool pair (integer or string). Use 0 for ALGO.

assetBAmount.description: Amount of asset B in base units for add-liquidity shapes (integer string recommended).

poolTokenAmount.description: Pool token amount in base units for remove-liquidity shapes (integer string recommended).

depositAssetId.description: Asset id to deposit for single-asset add-liquidity (must match assetAId or assetBId).

depositAmount.description: Deposit amount in base units for single-asset add-liquidity (integer string recommended).

outputAssetId.description: Asset id to receive for single-asset-out remove-liquidity (must match assetAId or assetBId).

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum tolerated slippage in basis points for Tinyman shapes.

poolAppId.description: Folks Finance pool application id (from discovery opportunityId).

assetId.description: Underlying asset id for Folks Finance pool selection (from discovery assetIds).

assetAmount.description: Underlying asset amount in base units for Folks deposit shapes.

amount.description: Withdraw amount in base units for Folks withdraw shapes.

amountDenomination.description: Whether Folks withdraw amount is expressed in underlying asset or fAsset units.

includeOpUp.description: Whether to prefix Folks deposit groups with an OpUp transaction (default true).

escrowAddress.description: Folks Finance deposit or loan escrow address. Resolved via indexer when omitted on deposit/withdraw shapes.

loanAppId.description: Folks Finance loan application id (distinct from pool app id). Defaults to MainnetLoans.GENERAL when omitted on loan credit shapes.

marketAppId.description: CompX or Dork.fi lending market application id.

borrowAmount.description: Amount to borrow in base units (integer string recommended).

collateralAmount.description: Collateral amount in base units for CompX borrow shapes (LST-denominated).

collateralTokenId.description: Collateral LST asset id for CompX borrow shapes. Must be in the market's on-chain accepted_collaterals set (often a cross-market LST such as cUSDC). Defaults to the market LST when omitted.

caveatsDocsPath.description: Repository-relative path to protocol-specific execution construction caveats (pool discovery, opt-ins, min-balance, slippage, liquidity limits, app upgrades).

requiredInputs.description: Input field names required by POST /execution/quotes for this shapeKey.

docsPath.description: Repository-relative path to shape documentation when available.

quotes.description: One or more independent quote requests. Each item compiles to its own unsigned transaction group; groups are never merged. Price is flat per request (not per item).

evmCall.description: Unsigned EVM call. Present when type is evm.

chain.description: Settlement chain. Present on Base/EVM quotes.

data.description: Compiled quotes in the same order as request.quotes.

AlgorandBaseUnitAmount.description: Positive integer amount in the asset's base units. A decimal string is preferred to preserve precision.

address.description: Algorand account that will sign and submit the eventual swap.

fromAssetId.description: Input ASA id; use 0 for ALGO.

toAssetId.description: Output ASA id; use 0 for ALGO.

router.description: Force a single adapter. Omit to quote every enabled router and pick the best net return.

slippage.description: Percent (0-100) used at quote time for routers that bake slippage into min-out. Default 1.

disabledProtocols.description: Additional DEX protocols to exclude from routing. Tinyman (v1), Humble, Algofi, and Algomint are always disabled by canix402.

HaystackSwapQuote.description: Serializable multi-router swap quote. Preserve this object unchanged when calling the opt-in and transaction endpoints. payload is opaque winner state — do not edit it.

quotedAmount.description: Expected net output base units for the winning route.

expiresAt.description: Reject the quote after this time and fetch a fresh one.

payload.description: Opaque winner-native quote. Pass back unchanged.

slippage.description: Maximum unfavorable movement as a percentage; for example, 1 means 1%.

encodedTransaction.description: Base64-encoded unsigned transaction bytes for inspection and caller signing.

signedTransaction.description: Base64-encoded Haystack-signed blob when this member is already signed.

signer.description: Who supplies the signature for this group member.

transactions.description: Atomic-group order. Do not reorder members.

userSignIndexes.description: Indexes the caller wallet must sign. Preserve Haystack-signed members unchanged.

OpportunityExecutionInputHints.description: Allowlisted selector hints derived from the opportunity. Amounts never appear.

validatorId.description: Réti validator id (stake target). Amounts never appear in hints.

loanAppId.description: Folks Finance loan application id (distinct from pool app id).

tierIndex.description: STAMM fee-tier index (0–5) when the LP ASA is a STAMM tier token.

assetAddress.description: Underlying ERC-20 address for EVM venues. Amounts never appear.

order.description: Execution order for multi-step opens. Alternatives share order 0.

prerequisiteShapeKeys.description: Shape keys that must be completed before this step.

requiredAssetIds.description: ASA ids the wallet must hold (or acquire) before entry. ALGO is 0.

amount.description: Minimum amount in base units as a decimal string.

nfd.description: NFD app id or name used for linked-creator gating.

nfdRoot.description: NFD root app id or name for segment ownership gating.

OpportunityEntryRequirements.description: Discovery-time entry eligibility. Quote-time on-chain checks remain authoritative.

gateMatch.description: How multiple ASA gates combine. Réti uses any.

eligibilityFullyCheckable.description: False when gates include NFD/creator kinds that personalized matching cannot resolve.

stakerSlotsRemaining.description: Remaining staker ledger slots across pools, or null if unknown.

algoRoomMicroAlgos.description: Remaining ALGO headroom in microAlgos, or null if unknown.

opportunityIds.description: Opportunity ids to check, in request order.

refresh.description: Bypass Redis and refetch adapters; still writes a fresh cache entry.

healthFactor.description: Wallet health factor for this lending venue when positions already expose it. Omitted when no snapshot exists; never invented.

address.description: Algorand account address that will sign returned groups.

swapSlippage.description: Swap slippage percent (0–100) for swap-aware compose. Default 1.

schemaVersion.description: Versioned policy contract id. Unknown versions fail closed.

maxProtocolWeightBps.description: Cap any single protocol at this share of the subject (10000 = 100%).

minAlgoReserveMicroAlgos.description: Wallet ALGO that must remain after the subject (microAlgos decimal string).

maxSourceAgeSeconds.description: Maximum age of sourceTimestamp relative to evaluatedAt.

plan.description: Compiled POST /plans or /plans/rebalance payload (full envelope or inner data).

walletAlgoMicroAlgos.description: Wallet ALGO balance in microAlgos. Required when minAlgoReserveMicroAlgos is set.

sender.description: Sender used for GET /fetch/discount, or null when no address was supplied.

userFeeDiscount.description: Percent off the ~0.1% Folks Router fee (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, or 50).

applied.description: True when sender was set and userFeeDiscount was passed to GET /fetch/quote.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment required, or a prepaid session failure when X-Canix-Session was sent. Without a session header, retry with a signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. If X-Canix-Session was sent, the body is SESSION_INVALID / SESSION_EXPIRED / SESSION_EXHAUSTED / SESSION_UNAVAILABLE and PAYMENT-REQUIRED is absent — omit the session header to fall back to a one-shot.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded JSON x402 payment requirements the client must satisfy before retrying.

NotFound.description: Requested resource or shape was not found.

UpstreamRateLimited.description: The Haystack upstream rate limit was exceeded. Retry after the interval advertised by the response when available.

UpstreamError.description: Haystack or an Algorand network dependency was unavailable.

SessionError.description: Prepaid session receipt error. Not an x402 payment challenge — PAYMENT-REQUIRED is absent.

WatchError.description: Watch retainer receipt error. Not an x402 payment challenge — PAYMENT-REQUIRED is absent. Register again with POST /watch or rotate with X-Canix-Watch-Secret.

endpointPolicy.summary: Top 10 aggregated DeFi opportunities ranked by risk then APY
endpointPolicy.description: Returns ranked Algorand DeFi yield opportunities across supported protocols including Tinyman, Pact, Folks Finance, CompX, Dork.fi, Myth Finance, and Haystack. Use when an agent needs to compare APY/APR, TVL, asset pairs, opportunity type, protocol, source freshness, and caveats before presenting or ranking yield options. This endpoint provides normalized market data only; it does not build or submit transactions.

executionShapes.title: Tinyman v2 flexible add liquidity
executionShapes.summary: Adds two-sided liquidity to an existing Tinyman AMM v2 pool using flexible amounts. Generates the documented 3-transaction group (asset1 transfer, asset2 transfer/payment, add_liquidity app call) as unsigned transactions.

executionShapes.title: Tinyman v2 initial add liquidity
executionShapes.summary: Adds the first liquidity to a bootstrapped but empty Tinyman AMM v2 pool. Generates the documented 3-transaction group (asset1 transfer, asset2 transfer/payment, add_initial_liquidity app call) as unsigned transactions.

executionShapes.title: Tinyman v2 single-asset add liquidity
executionShapes.summary: Adds one-sided liquidity to an existing Tinyman AMM v2 pool. Tinyman performs an internal swap to balance the deposit and mints pool tokens. Generates the documented 2-transaction group (asset transfer/payment, add_liquidity app call) as unsigned transactions.

data.notes: Réti validator-level consensus staking; quote-time eligibility checks are authoritative.

executionShapes.title: Réti ALGO stake to validator
executionShapes.summary: Stakes ALGO to a Réti validator via ValidatorRegistry.addStake. The registry allocates into one of the validator's pools. Builds gas ×2, ALGO payment to the registry, addStake, and optional reward-token opt-in. Enforces minEntryStake, capacity, and entry gates at quote time.

compatibleExitShapes.title: Réti ALGO unstake from pool
compatibleExitShapes.summary: Removes ALGO stake from a Réti staking pool via StakingPool.removeStake. Builds gas ×2, removeStake, and optional reward-token opt-in. Partial unstake must leave at least minEntryStake (or unstake the full balance).

executionShapes.title: Folks Finance v2 add deposit escrow
executionShapes.summary: Creates and funds a new Folks Finance deposit escrow for the user. Returns a 3-transaction group that must be signed by both the user and the generated escrow account.

executionShapes.title: Folks Finance v2 opt deposit escrow into pool fAsset
executionShapes.summary: Funds and opts an existing Folks Finance deposit escrow into a pool fAsset so it can receive deposits.

executionShapes.title: Folks Finance v2 escrow deposit
executionShapes.summary: Deposits an underlying asset into a Folks Finance lending pool via a deposit escrow. fAssets accrue in the escrow rather than the user's wallet. Generates the SDK deposit group (asset transfer + deposit app call), optionally prefixed with OpUp.

executionShapes.title: Tinyman v2 flexible add liquidity

CanixSessionHeader.name: X-Canix-Session
CanixSessionHeader.description: Prepaid session receipt (csess_ + 32-byte hex). When present on a session-eligible route, Caddy skips x402 and the app consumes one research or quotes unit. Omit to pay per request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
